lines.en: Last summer, I went to Alexandria with my family.
It was raining when we arrived at the hotel.
First, we left our bags in the room.
Then we walked along the beach for an hour.
Suddenly, my little brother fell into the water.
Luckily, he was fine, and everyone laughed.
After that, we had fish for dinner.
In the end, it was the best trip of the year.
I will never forget that day.
Now it's your turn. Tell me a story.
